from __future__ import annotations
from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, String, Text, Uuid, Table, Column from sqlalchemy.orm import backref, relationship from app.core.base import Base from app.core.fields import field
# Tabla de asociación M2M entre Suggestion y Tag suggestion_tag_association = Table( "feedback_moderation_suggestion_tag", Base.metadata, Column("suggestion_id", Integer, ForeignKey("feedback_moderation_suggestion.id", ondelete="CASCADE")), Column("tag_id", Integer, ForeignKey("feedback_moderation_tag.id", ondelete="CASCADE")), )
class Suggestion(Base): __tablename__ = "feedback_moderation_suggestion" __abstract__ = False __model__ = "suggestion" __service__ = "modules.feedback_moderation.services.moderation.SuggestionService"
__selector_config__ = { "label_field": "title", "search_fields": ["title", "content", "author_email"], "columns": [ {"field": "id", "label": "ID"}, {"field": "title", "label": "Título"}, {"field": "status", "label": "Estado"}, {"field": "author_name", "label": "Autor"}, {"field": "is_public", "label": "Público"}, ], }
title = field(String(180), required=True, public=True, editable=True) content = field(Text, required=True, public=True, editable=True) status = field(String(20), required=True, public=True, editable=False, default="pending") author_email = field(String(255), required=True, public=True, editable=False) author_name = field(String(180), required=False, public=True, editable=False) is_public = field(Boolean, required=True, public=True, editable=False, default=False) moderation_note = field(Text, required=False, public=False, editable=True) published_at = field(DateTime(timezone=True), required=False, public=True, editable=False) reviewed_by_id = field(Uuid, ForeignKey("core_user.id"), required=False, public=False, editable=False) reviewed_by = relationship("User", foreign_keys=lambda: [Suggestion.reviewed_by_id]) tags = relationship( "modules.feedback_moderation.models.moderation.Tag", secondary=suggestion_tag_association, backref=backref("suggestions"), ) comments = relationship( "modules.feedback_moderation.models.moderation.Comment", foreign_keys=lambda: [Comment.suggestion_id], backref="suggestion", )
class Comment(Base): __tablename__ = "feedback_moderation_comment" __abstract__ = False __model__ = "comment" __service__ = "modules.feedback_moderation.services.moderation.CommentService"
__selector_config__ = { "label_field": "content", "search_fields": ["content", "author_email"], "columns": [ {"field": "id", "label": "ID"}, {"field": "suggestion", "label": "Sugerencia"}, {"field": "status", "label": "Estado"}, {"field": "author_email", "label": "Autor"}, ], }
suggestion_id = field( Integer, ForeignKey("feedback_moderation_suggestion.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), required=True, public=True, ) content = field(Text, required=True, public=True, editable=True) status = field(String(20), required=True, public=True, editable=False, default="pending") author_email = field(String(255), required=True, public=True, editable=False) is_public = field(Boolean, required=True, public=True, editable=False, default=False) published_at = field(DateTime(timezone=True), required=False, public=True, editable=False)
class Tag(Base): __tablename__ = "feedback_moderation_tag" __abstract__ = False __model__ = "tag" __service__ = "modules.feedback_moderation.services.moderation.TagService"
__selector_config__ = { "label_field": "name", "search_fields": ["name", "slug"], "columns": [ {"field": "id", "label": "ID"}, {"field": "name", "label": "Nombre"}, {"field": "slug", "label": "Slug"}, {"field": "color", "label": "Color"}, ], }
name = field(String(100), required=True, public=True, editable=True) slug = field(String(100), required=True, public=True, editable=True, unique=True) color = field(String(7), required=False, public=True, editable=True, default="#999999")
